statements.text: For many China-origin bare PCBs under HTS 8534.00 and certain PCBAs under HTS 8473.30.1180, the additional Section 301 tariff is 25% unless a product-specific exclusion applies.

Section 301 tariffs add an extra duty to covered China-origin goods on top of the normal HTS duty rate.
A Section 301 tariff is a U.S. trade remedy duty applied to specific products from China following a trade investigation.
In April 2025, the United States has implemented new tariffs on Chinese imports, including printed circuit boards (PCBs) and custom-made technical parts.
